lyrics.label: Fetch lyrics from lrclib.net
lyrics.description: Sends the playing track's artist, title, album and length to lrclib.net, once per track. Results are cached.

lyrics_backup.label: Backup lyrics sources
lyrics_backup.description: Also asks NetEase Cloud Music (music.163.com) and Kugou (kugou.com), both China-based, for every track, alongside lrclib.net: the track's artist and title, and its length for Kugou.

lyrics_offset_ms.label: Lyrics timing (ms)
lyrics_offset_ms.description: Shifts synced lyrics. Positive values show each line earlier, negative values later.

show_art.label: Show album art
show_art.description: Shows the cover next to the title. Without it, a status icon is shown.

show_artist.label: Show artist
show_artist.description: Shows the artist after the title.

max_width.label: Title width (px)
max_width.description: Longest the title may get on the bar. 0 shows only the cover and the meter.

hide_when_idle.label: Hide when nothing plays
hide_when_idle.description: Hides the widget while every player is paused or stopped, or none is open. Otherwise a music icon stays on the bar.

audio_spectrum.label: Spectrum meter
audio_spectrum.description: Shows a live spectrum of what you hear while a player is playing.

audio_spectrum_bands.label: Spectrum bars
audio_spectrum_bands.description: Number of bars in the meter.

open_in_background.label: Open apps in the background
open_in_background.description: On Hyprland, apps opened from Encore start on a hidden workspace, so no window appears. A panel button shows or hides it. Elsewhere apps open normally.

play_on_open.label: Play when opened
play_on_open.description: Presses play once an app opened from Encore is ready, so it resumes where you left off.

liked_songs.label: Liked Songs in favourites
liked_songs.description: Lists your Spotify Liked Songs first among the favourites. Spotify only opens it: press play there.

favourites.label: Favourites
favourites.description: Spotify playlists, albums, artists or tracks to start from the panel and launcher. Paste a share link or spotify: URI, optionally as Name = link. Links can also be pasted straight into the panel's Favourites tab, and names are filled in from Spotify.

pause_others.label: Pause other players
pause_others.description: When a player starts playing, pause every other player, so a video tab stops when Spotify starts.

bar_lyrics.label: Lyrics on the bar
bar_lyrics.description: Shows the current lyric line instead of the title while synced lyrics play.

overlay_output.label: Lyrics overlay monitor
overlay_output.description: Where the lyrics overlay appears: a monitor name such as DP-1, all for every monitor, or empty for the focused one.

overlay_size.label: Overlay text size
overlay_size.description: Size of the lyrics overlay's text, in pixels.

overlay_position.label: Overlay position
overlay_position.description: Where on the screen the lyrics overlay sits.

overlay_offset.label: Overlay distance from edge (px)
overlay_offset.description: How far the lyrics overlay sits from the screen edges it is placed against (none in the centre).

overlay_background.label: Overlay background (%)
overlay_background.description: How solid the pill behind the lyrics is. 0 shows the text alone.

overlay_highlight.label: Overlay highlighting
overlay_highlight.description: Words lights each word as it is sung when the lyrics have word timing (NetEase has it for many tracks), and the whole line when they don't. Line always lights the whole line.

overlay_cover.label: Overlay cover
overlay_cover.description: Shows the album cover beside the lyric.

overlay_next_line.label: Overlay next line
overlay_next_line.description: Shows the upcoming line, dimmed, under the current one.
